title: Abhayapura Vidyalaya
description: Support for practical learning at H/ Abhayapura Junior School, alongside a school tree-planting activity.
details: H/ Abhayapura Junior School is in the Abhayapura area of Lunugamwehera Division, Hambantota District. AKOFE's source page reports 122 enrolled students and describes the school's need for equipment to support practical activities and students' educational development.
After the main programme, KOICA and AKOFE organized a tree-planting activity. One hundred fruit and herbal Ayurvedic plants were planted on the school premises.

title: St. Coombs Maha Vidyalaya School Support
description: Educational supplies, medical-aid kits, shoes, sports items, and a photocopy machine for a rural school serving over 775 students.
details: In May 2023, KOICA and AKOFE supported CP/N/St. Coombs Maha Vidyalaya in Thalawakelle. The initiative aimed to improve educational opportunities for more than 775 students.
The project supplied stationery for Grades 1–5, medical-aid kits, shoes for selected students, sports items, and a photocopy machine for school operations.

title: St. Coombs Estate Dispensary Healthcare Support
description: Healthcare equipment, medicines, emergency supplies, a drinking-water filter, and dispensary repairs for a rural community.
details: On 6 May 2023, KOICA-funded healthcare support was coordinated by AKOFE at St. Coombs Estate Dispensary in Thalawakelle. The dispensary serves more than 3,500 villagers and had requested help with essential healthcare supplies.
The support included medical and examination equipment, vital medicines, emergency supplies, a water filter for safe drinking water, and repairs and repainting to the dispensary gate.
